Nine comments

Here is one of the simplest of reels but fun nevertheless. The challenge is to vary it in such a way as to avoid it sounding tedious.

↳ Posted by milesnagopaleen on February 19th, 2003.

This tune lends itself to variation, Here are a few ideas (unabashedly biased toward fiddle ’cause that’s what I play).

M: 4/4
